summary: Mega Matrix Inc, a Cayman-incorporated foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing discloses share counts across Preferred, Class A, Class B, and Class C stock as of September 1 and 15, 2026, warrant valuations dated August 2024 and January 2024, and related-party balances tied to individuals Yucheng Hu and Quleduo. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is announced. As a routine periodic report mapped to a US quarterly filing, there are no deal terms, no board recommendation, and no risk-arb angle to monitor.
